propositions: Copilot CLI silently drops skills with frontmatter exceeding 1024-character description limit or containing unparseable YAML (unquoted colons, invalid scalars).
Three symlinked rebar skills fail to register: rebar-implement and rebar-janitor exceed the 1024-char description cap; rebar-debug contains unquoted colon breaking YAML parse.
Fix is to convert descriptions to YAML folded block scalars and trim over-cap descriptions to ≤1024 characters while preserving invocation triggers.
New deterministic lint check (scripts/check_skill_frontmatter.py) must validate all SKILL.md frontmatters for YAML parse, non-empty description ≤1024 chars, and name format compliance.
Lint check must be wired into make lint target and accompanied by unit tests covering happy path and failure cases (over-cap, empty, unparseable, bad name).
